item.title: WRESTLING: Ex-West Scranton star Turi embraces challenge at Seminary
item.description: KINGSTON – Michael Turi had a decision. And it was a major one. On one side of the coin was an opportunity most covet. A chance to wrestle at one of the top high school wrestling schools in the nation. A once-in-a-lifetime chance, some will say. The flip side was the chance to set records. Turi, a three-time Class 3A state-placer – including a third-place finish as a junior at West Scranton – could have rewrote the Invader record books, and maybe, those in District 2. item.title: D2 BASKETBALL: Rematches highlight semifinal games
item.description: The opening night of the District 2 basketball tournament brought little intrigue. For the most part, the expected winners all won with possibly one minor upset when the Valley West girls defeated Wilkes-Barre Area in the Class 6A girls quarterfinals. Valley West entered the game on a nine-game losing streak and after winning just two games all season. The Spartans were the fifth seed and held the No. 4 seeded Wolfpack to just 23 points.
